scenarios.name: Summary guidance and setup status remain legible on the actual light card
scenarios.given: the actual Summary translation controls on a light iPhone card with missing language packs and an original summary
scenarios.when: the user opens translation options and requests translation without preparing packs
scenarios.then: the rendered guidance and setup text each meet the4.5:1 small-text benchmark, preserve originals and do not start preparation or recording

scenarios.name: Native translation status stays legible across appearance and text size
scenarios.given: the actual production status view on its native card in light/dark, normal/increased contrast and normal/accessibility text sizes
scenarios.when: UIKit traits reach the SwiftUI environment and the actual text is rendered
scenarios.then: the resolved native surface matches the render and actual status text meets4.5:1 with native RGBA evidence retained
